; Sector 3 creature script (example for the annotation tests).
; Written by hand.

touch_return:   ; creatures that only bounce back
    Return
    ; then idle for a while
    Padding 1

    Padding 8

; The dive.
; It starts with two ticks of waiting.
foe0_ink:
    Wait_Next_Tick
    Wait_Next_Tick
    Set_Frame 32 ; the diving frame
    Move_Foe_Relative_XY -4 -5 0

swim_back:
    ; three frames, then loop
    Set_Frame 33
    Wait_Next_Tick
    Set_Frame 34
    Wait_Next_Tick
dive_end:
    Loop_Counter2_Back_To swim_back 29      ; 29 times
    Set_Frame 30
    Move_Foe_Relative_XY 4 5 0
    Return

foe6_ink:
    Wait_Next_Tick
    Wait_Next_Tick
    Set_Frame 32
    Move_Foe_Relative_XY -12 28 0

loc_555:
    Set_Frame 33
    Wait_Next_Tick
    Set_Frame 34
    Wait_Next_Tick
    Loop_Counter2_Back_To loc_555 29
    Set_Frame 7
    Move_Foe_Relative_XY 12 -28 0
    Return

foe12_ink:
    Wait_Next_Tick
    Wait_Next_Tick
    Set_Frame 32
    Move_Foe_Relative_XY 2 -8 0

loc_581:
    Set_Frame 33
    Wait_Next_Tick
    Set_Frame 34
    Wait_Next_Tick
    Loop_Counter2_Back_To loc_581 29
    Set_Frame 30
    Move_Foe_Relative_XY -2 8 0
    Return
    Padding 2
    ; The following instructions are not executed -- nothing jumps to them
    Set_Frame 32
    Move_Foe_Relative_XY 0 -11 0

loc_607:
    ; The following instructions are not executed -- nothing jumps to them
    Set_Frame 33
    Wait_Next_Tick
    Set_Frame 34
    Wait_Next_Tick
    Loop_Counter2_Back_To loc_607 29
    Set_Frame 30
    Move_Foe_Relative_XY 0 11 0
    Return
    Padding 2
    Set_Frame 32
    Move_Foe_Relative_XY 0 -3 0

loc_633:
    ; The following instructions are not executed -- nothing jumps to them
    Set_Frame 33
    Wait_Next_Tick
    Set_Frame 34
    Wait_Next_Tick
    Loop_Counter2_Back_To loc_633 29
    Set_Frame 30
    Move_Foe_Relative_XY 0 3 0
    Return
    Padding 30

loc_681:
    Move_Foe_Relative_XY 0 0 1
    Loop_Counter0_Back_To loc_681 28

foe0_start:
    Move_Foe_Relative_XY 0 3 1
    Loop_Counter0_Back_To foe0_start 10
    Set_Frame 19
    Wait_Next_Tick
    Set_Frame 20
    Wait_Next_Tick
    Play_Sound 10
    Wake_Foe 1
    Set_Frame 21
    Wait_Next_Tick

loc_712:
    Move_Foe_Relative_XY 0 0 1
    Loop_Counter0_Back_To loc_712 5

loc_721:
    Move_Foe_Relative_XY 0 -3 1
    Loop_Counter0_Back_To loc_721 10
    Jump_To loc_681
    Padding 4

foe1_start:
    Show_Foe
    Move_Foe_To_XY 130 77 22

loc_742:
    Move_Foe_Relative_XY -10 0 0
    Loop_Counter0_Back_To loc_742 23

loc_751:
    Put_Foe_To_Sleep 1
    Hide_Foe
    Jump_To foe1_start

foe1_hit:
    Loop_Counter0_Back_To foe1_hit 1
    Jump_To loc_751
    Padding 11

foe2_start:
    Move_Foe_Relative_XY 4 0 1
    Loop_Counter0_Back_To foe2_start 17

loc_785:
    Move_Foe_Relative_XY 4 -4 1
    Loop_Counter0_Back_To loc_785 7

loc_794:
    Move_Foe_Relative_XY 4 0 1
    Loop_Counter0_Back_To loc_794 12

loc_803:
    Move_Foe_Relative_XY -4 0 1 mirrored
    Loop_Counter0_Back_To loc_803 12

loc_812:
    Move_Foe_Relative_XY -4 4 1 mirrored
    Loop_Counter0_Back_To loc_812 7

loc_821:
    Move_Foe_Relative_XY -4 0 1 mirrored
    Loop_Counter0_Back_To loc_821 17
    Jump_To foe2_start
    Padding 7

foe3_start:

    Loop_Counter0_Back_To foe3_start 5
    Set_Frame 11
    Wait_Next_Tick
    Set_Frame_Range 12 13
    Set_Frame 12
    Wait_Next_Tick

loc_858:
    Move_Foe_Relative_XY -6 0 1
    Loop_Counter0_Back_To loc_858 14
    Set_Frame 11
    Wait_Next_Tick
    Set_Frame_Range 9 10
    Set_Frame 10
    Wait_Next_Tick

loc_876:
    Move_Foe_Relative_XY 0 0 1
    Loop_Counter0_Back_To loc_876 3

    Move_Foe_Relative_XY 0 0 1 mirrored
    Loop_Counter0_Back_To loc_885 7
    Set_Frame 11 mirrored
    Wait_Next_Tick
    Set_Frame_Range 12 13
    Set_Frame 12 mirrored
    Wait_Next_Tick

foe5_start:
    Wait_Next_Tick
    If_Sub_Y_Less 100
    Jump_To foe5_start
    If_Sub_X_Less 50
    Jump_To foe5_start
    Show_Foe

loc_1016:
    Move_Foe_Relative_XY 0 -3 1
    Loop_Counter0_Back_To loc_1016 14

loc_1025:
    Set_Frame 38
    Move_Foe_Relative_XY -20 0 0
    Play_Sound 0
    Set_Frame 39
    Wait_Next_Tick
    Set_Frame 38
    Wait_Next_Tick
    Set_Frame 37
    Move_Foe_Relative_XY 20 0 0
